## Summary

Describe the user problem and the smallest safe change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] `npm run security:audit`
- [ ] Manual keyboard/mobile/reload check where relevant

## Data, privacy, and safety

- [ ] No real aquarium backup, token, endpoint, or personal data is included.
- [ ] Persisted-schema or backup changes include migration/fixture documentation.
- [ ] No diagnosis, speculative genetics claim, or automatic equipment actuation was introduced.
